result.final:
Fixed the wfmt package to match the authoritative samples in assets/ (docs/FORMAT.md is a stale draft).

Layout recovered from samples: header = magic "WFMT" (4) + version (1) + record count as LITTLE-endian u32 (4); records = tag uvarint + length uvarint + payload, zero-padded so each record's own encoded size is a multiple of ALIGN=4; trailer = 4-byte little-endian CRC-32 over everything before it. Verified against sample.wfmt: records (1,"alpha"), (2,b""), (300,"x"*10), (4,bytes(0..255)), (70000,"z") with pads 1,2,3,1,3 landing exactly on the trailer at 0x131 of 309 bytes.

Changes:
- varint.py: decode_uvarint was reading only one byte and discarding the continuation bit (root cause of the sample incompatibility — tags like 300/70000 decoded wrong). Now a full LEB128 loop; raises kind="truncated" when data ends mid-varint, kind="varint" on over-long encoding or >64-bit values. Added MAX_BYTES.
- header.py: count field switched from big-endian ">I" to little-endian "<I" in both pack_
